blocks.text: Volatile organic compounds (VOCs) organic compounds ka ek bara group hai jo kamre ke temperature par aasani se bhaap (evaporate) ban jate hain. VOCs kuch solids ya liquids se gas ban kar nikalte hain. Liquid fuels VOCs ke bare sources hain jo bahar ki hawa ko kharab karte hain. Gariyon ka exhaust, aur liquid fossil fuels, lakri aur koora (garbage) jalana, sab VOCs ko atmosphere mein chhorte hain.

VOCs ke saamne rehne (exposure) se sehat par kai asraat hote hain. Thori der (short term) ke exposure se aankh, naak aur gale mein jalan, sar dard aur matli (nausea) hoti hai; lambe arse (long term) ke exposure se jigar (liver), gurde (kidney) aur central nervous system ko nuqsan hota hai. VOCs ghar ke andar (indoor) aur bahar (outdoor) dono ki air pollution mein bara hissa dalte hain. Kuch aam VOCs benzene, xylene, toluene, ethanol, formaldehyde aur acetone hain.

blocks.prompt: VOCs hawa ke mayar (air quality) par kaise asar dalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh fuels, solvents, jalti lakri aur koore se bhaap ban kar hawa mein aate hain. Wahan seedhe aankhon aur saans ki nali mein jalan karte hain, aur dhoop mein NOₓ ke saath mil kar photochemical smog ki ozone aur PAN banate hain. Lamba exposure jigar, gurdon aur nervous system ko nuqsan deta hai.

items: VOCs aasani se bhaap bante hain (benzene, xylene, toluene, ethanol, formaldehyde, acetone); fuels, exhaust, lakri aur koore se.
Short term: jalan, sar dard, matli; long term: jigar, gurde aur nervous system ko nuqsan.
